Game Overview

At its heart, Magnet Balls Addictive is a bubble shooter game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Magnet Balls Addictive keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Magnet Balls Addictive?

Magnet Balls Addictive is a free bubble shooter game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Magnet Balls Addictive free to play?

Yes, Magnet Balls Addictive is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
